LOC_BLANK: numeric; count of blank lines in the code
BRANCH_COUNT: numeric; number of branches in the flow graph
CALL_PAIRS: numeric; number of function call pairs
LOC_CODE_AND_COMMENT: numeric; count of lines that contain both code and comments
LOC_COMMENTS: numeric; count of lines containing comments
CONDITION_COUNT: numeric; count of conditions in the code
CYCLOMATIC_DENSITY: numeric; ratio of cyclomatic complexity to decision count
DECISION_COUNT: numeric; number of decisions (branches) in the code
DECISION_DENSITY: numeric; ratio of decisions to the number of lines of code
DESIGN_DENSITY: numeric; ratio of design complexity to decision count
EDGE_COUNT: numeric; number of edges in the flow graph
ESSENTIAL_DENSITY: numeric; ratio of essential complexity to decision count
LOC_EXECUTABLE: numeric; count of executable lines of code
PARAMETER_COUNT: numeric; number of parameters in functions
NODE_COUNT: numeric; number of nodes in the flow graph
NUM_OPERANDS: numeric; number of operands in the code
NUM_OPERATORS: numeric; number of operators in the code
NUM_UNIQUE_OPERANDS: numeric; count of unique operands in the code
NUM_UNIQUE_OPERATORS: numeric; count of unique operators in the code
NUMBER_OF_LINES: numeric; total number of lines in the code
PERCENT_COMMENTS: numeric; percentage of lines that are comments
